correctness.rationale: The repaired theorem quantifies over exactly three deletions and connected surviving graphs, inclusive radius two in their new metric, with reduced F2 coefficients. I reconstructed the clique and boundary proof and independently enumerated the Fano plane via orthogonality of nonzero binary vectors, using bit-mask two-step adjacency, all subsets, and row rather than column elimination. Replay: python3 /workspace/branches/reproduce_fano.py. Every one of 1,316 connected triples passed the degree-two formula and vanishing in other degrees; 14 disconnected. Ranks 5,6,7 occur 1232,56,28 times. The three induced-matching types each have 28 elements, and no induced matching of size four exists. No integral or homotopy conclusion is inferred. The original verifier and output still support the repaired theorem and are unchanged.
